name: Total solar eclipse, Apr 8 2024 (demo)
description: Replay: the real April 8 2024 path of totality (Texas to Maine) with the weather of Sept 12, 2026 standing in for the day, which had rain clearing up across the Midwest. Search a place inside the blue band and press Play to watch the sky change hour by hour. The band shows at every hour, as if totality happened then.
